rationale.usefulness: Source selection, citations and diverse study formats offer strong practical educational value (creative-nl-about, creative-nl-students); concrete import checks and reviewed-artifact workflow make the proposals actionable.
rationale.impact: Connecting curated evidence to study and multimedia production can materially influence educational workflows (creative-nl-sources, creative-nl-video), though this baseline supplies no measured learning or field-wide model advance.
rationale.novelty: The integrated source-to-chat/study/video workflow is meaningfully differentiated (creative-nl-students, creative-nl-video); the July rename itself is not a novel capability and the article properly avoids treating it as one.
rationale.maturity: Detailed current import, access, sharing and generation documentation supports a developed usable service, while documented inaccuracies, processing time and account restrictions limit dependability (creative-nl-video, creative-nl-sources).
rationale.openness: Inspectable citations and some downloadable outputs offer limited portability; closed hosted processing, account gates and restricted notebook sharing/export prevent a high openness rating (creative-nl-video, creative-nl-about).

concerns: Non-blocking: one Google source family, no generated-artifact trial or learner-outcome experiment.
